newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Peters says significant NZ welfare changes planned.
newsitem.headline: Peters says significant NZ welfare changes planned.

text.p: New Zealand Treasurer Winston Peters said on Friday that the government would shortly outline important changes in social welfare.
Peters said in a speech in Auckland that the government aimed to provide an environment conducive to sustainable growth, more jobs, and higher quality education and social services.

"In return, we expect each and every New Zealander to live up to their responsibilities and make a contribution to New Zealand's prosperity, and while I do not intend to signal today, I intend shortly to be outlining the significant changes that we need to have in our approach to social welfare in this country," Peters said.
Peters did not elaborate and his press spokesman declined to give further detail.
